assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a game sprite atlas that matches these EXISTING GAME images EXACTLY in drawing style. Input images 1-4 are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets. The first image's round white sleepy cat is the actual PLAYER: its very thick BLACK uneven marker outline, extremely simple rounded blob forms, half-closed circular sleepy eyes, two tiny freckle dots on each cheek, tiny goofy open mouth, muted pastel flat fill, almost no shading are MANDATORY for every creature. The grey golem reference is the exact golem body to adapt with a few large simple green triangular thorns. Companion reference shows exact creature style to follow. This must look drawn by the same artist for this same game. NOT ornate fantasy art, NOT detailed, NOT shiny, NOT realistic, NOT gradients, NOT 3D, NO ornamental armor detail, no fine linework, no complex scales. Tiny simple black line doodles with broad pastel fill areas, 3-5 colors each at most. Even high tier items stay deliberately simple and funny.
Transparent PNG atlas, exactly 6 columns and 6 rows of equal cells in a square, every sprite centered and fully contained in CENTRAL 70% of its own cell, large empty transparent gutters. No words, numbers, gridlines, decorative borders, or floor shadows.
Row-major content:
Row1: simple pale blue sword pointing RIGHT with small gold crossguard; round grey golem as reference with 6 green thorns; round green angry cactus with short arms and black prickles; simple 3-swoosh orange fire tornado; sharp pale blue six-blade throwing star with bold black edges; simple round red sleepy dragon HEAD facing RIGHT with 2 cream horns.
Row2: simple pale peach open palm with exactly five rounded fingers and 2 palm creases; simple red missile with yellow nose pointing RIGHT; round pastel tan lion HEAD with brown scalloped mane facing RIGHT; simple round white eagle HEAD with yellow hooked beak facing RIGHT; round green dinosaur HEAD with 3 blunt teeth facing RIGHT; simple flat yellow sun with 8 orange triangular rays.
Row3: round cactus companion with sleepy eyes; round thorn stone golem companion with sleepy eyes; round orange fire fox companion with one flame tail; round grey wind ninja tanuki companion with simple headband; round gold lion companion with tiny crown; round red dragon companion with tiny wings.
Row4: round white eagle companion with tiny purple wizard hat; round green dinosaur companion with simple shield; round grey missile robot companion with one red rocket; round yellow sun spirit companion with simple halo; simple mint thorn chestplate with 3 big spikes; simple pale cyan crystal chestplate with one diamond emblem.
Row5: simple lavender chestplate with two small wings; simple muted purple chestplate with one star; simple cream chestplate with one yellow sun emblem; simple green thorn wooden club pointing diagonally upper right; simple cyan crystal club pointing diagonally upper right; simple pale lavender bladed club pointing diagonally upper right.
Row6: simple purple club with one star emblem pointing diagonally upper right; simple pale gold sun club pointing diagonally upper right; plain small red dragon body bead with 2 black marks; plain small green chimera body bead with 2 black marks; simple two red dragon wings with black outlines; simple yellow impact starburst with black outline.
Match reference PLAYER thick black marker outline and low-detail doodle style above everything else.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game sprite animation strip. Use reference image 1 (existing grey golem animation) as the EXACT body design, line style, proportions, face and simplicity reference. Reference image 2 is the existing player and defines the same very thick black marker doodle outlines, flat soft pastel colors, half-closed simple eyes and cheek dots. Create a FIRE GOLEM variant: same round blob rock golem, muted charcoal-grey body, simple flat orange/red cracks, one simple orange flame tuft on head and small simple orange flame mitten fists. NO thorns. Same goofy angry sleepy face. NOT fantasy detailed, NOT shiny, NOT realistic, NO glow gradients, NO intricate surface detail. Broad flat fills, very thick black outlines exactly matching supplied originals.
A single horizontal transparent PNG animation strip exactly 4 equal square cells, image ratio 4:1 if supported otherwise 3:1 with 4 equal columns. Each character complete inside central 75% of cell, ample transparent gutters, identical scale and body center and feet baseline across frames. Four frames left to right: walk A left foot forward; walk B right foot forward; slam windup both fists raised; slam contact both fists lowered forward. No ground, shadows, lettering or gridlines. Match the existing grey golem reference closely; only fire-themed color/accessory and the four poses differ.
